name: @codebend3r/che
description: Helper scripts shared across machines, called by name from your shell and browsable through one menu
author: CJ Rivas (https://github.com/codebend3r)

scripts.ci: bun run --sequential lint format executable shebang test
scripts.lint: uv run --no-project --with-requirements requirements-dev.txt -- ruff check bin test
scripts.format: uv run --no-project --with-requirements requirements-dev.txt -- ruff format --check bin test
scripts.executable: find bin -type f -name '*.py' ! -perm -u+x -print0 | xargs -0 awk 'FNR==1 && /^#!/{print "Has a shebang but is not executable: " FILENAME; ec=1} END{exit ec+0}'
scripts.shebang: find bin -type f -name '*.py' -perm -u+x -print0 | xargs -0 awk 'FNR==1 && !/^#!/{print "Executable but has no shebang: " FILENAME; ec=1} END{exit ec+0}'
scripts.version: bun run generate && git add shell .zshrc README.md
